content.text:
A renewal is now refused with the reason `on-hold` when another member has a hold on the item that is waiting or ready for pickup. All 62 tests pass: the 59 existing ones and 3 new ones.

The change is in `lib/circulation/renewals.js`. `renewLoan` now calls the existing `findBlockingHold` from `checkout.js`, the same check checkout uses, so renewals and checkouts apply the same hold rule. The check runs after the unknown-loan, overdue and renewal-limit checks, so those reasons still come first. I didn't touch `lib/server/routes/loans.js`. The renew route already passes the reason through as a 409 error code, so `on-hold` reaches clients without further changes.

I added three tests in `test/renewals.test.js`:
- Another member's waiting hold refuses the renewal.
- Another member's ready hold refuses the renewal.
- Expired holds, collected holds and the borrower's own hold don't block a renewal.

My first attempt used one shell command to make all the edits, and the permission check denied it. I redid the work with the file-edit tools.

I did not record anything to Kronomind, since the `renewLoan` fact there is still accurate.
